title: ZJ05 MTD analysis package
description: Openly reusable R code, processed analysis inputs, an archived Bacon chronology model, and reproducible outputs for the 237 ka ZJ05 mass-transport-deposit analysis. The restricted ZJ05 planktonic foraminiferal oxygen-isotope measurements and GMGS seismic-reflection, high-resolution bathymetric and well-log datasets are not included.
